cases.sentence: Первосвященник Элиашиф и его собратья-священники принялись отстраивать овечьи ___.
cases.translation: High Priest Eliashib and his priestly brethren began building the Sheep Gate.
cases.explain: The direct object "ворота" requires the accusative case after the verb "отстраивать".

cases.translation: The adjacent section was built by the people of Jericho.
cases.explain: The genitive shows possession or origin after constructions like "жители" (people of).

cases.sentence: Рядом с ним восстанавливал Мишулам, сын ___.
cases.translation: Next to him, Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt.
cases.explain: Patronymic relationships are expressed in the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Старые ворота были восстановлены Айадой, сыном Пасиаха, и Мишуламом, сыном ___.
cases.translation: The Old Gate was rebuilt by Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah.
cases.explain: The genitive case marks paternity in naming conventions.

cases.sentence: Узиил, сын Харгайи, из ювелиров, восстановил следующий участок стены, а рядом с ним Ханания и составители ___.
cases.translation: Uzziel son of Harhaiah, of the goldsmiths, rebuilt the next section, and next to him Hananiah, one of the perfumers.
cases.explain: The genitive shows the group or type: "составители благовоний" (makers of perfumes).

cases.sentence: Рифая, сын Хура, правитель половины Иерусалимского округа, восстановил следующий участок, рядом с ними и напротив своего ___ восстанавливал Иедая.
cases.translation: Rephaiah son of Hur, ruler of half of the Jerusalem district, rebuilt.
cases.explain: Possession of a location is expressed in the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Шалум, сын Аллахеша, правитель второй половины Иерусалимского округа, с помощью своих дочерей восстановил следующий участок ___.
cases.translation: Shallum son of Halohesh, ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, rebuilt.
cases.explain: The genitive case follows constructions indicating the object of reconstruction.

cases.sentence: Ворота источника были восстановлены Шалуном, сыном Калхазея, правителем округа ___.
cases.translation: The Fountain Gate was repaired by Shallun son of Col-hozeh, ruler of the Mizpah district.
cases.explain: The preposition indicates location requires the prepositional case.

reading.question: What is the subject of this passage?
reading.explain: This section is titled "Строители стены" (The Builders of the Wall).

reading.ru: Первосвященник Элиашиф и его собратья-священники принялись отстраивать овечьи ворота.
reading.question: Who began the work of rebuilding?
options: High Priest Eliashib and his priestly brethren
reading.correct: High Priest Eliashib and his priestly brethren
reading.explain: The high priest and the priests under him started by rebuilding the Sheep Gate.

reading.ru: Соседний участок строили жители Иерихона, а рядом с ними строил Закур, сын Имрия.
reading.question: Who built the neighboring section?
options: The people of Jericho, with Zakur son of Imri next to them
reading.correct: The people of Jericho, with Zakur son of Imri next to them
reading.explain: The men of Jericho built their section, with Zakur son of Imri working beside them.

reading.ru: Рыбные ворота были отстроены сыновьями Синаи.
reading.question: Who rebuilt the Fish Gate?
reading.explain: The Fish Gate was built by the sons of Hassenaah (сыновья Синаи).

reading.ru: Следующий участок стены был восстановлен жителями Текоа, но их знать не подставило плечи под работу для своего владыки.
reading.question: What is notable about the work done by the men of Tekoa?
options: Their nobles did not work alongside them
reading.correct: Their nobles did not work alongside them
reading.explain: The men of Tekoa worked, but notably their nobles did not help with the work.

reading.ru: Шалум, сын Аллахеша, правитель второй половины Иерусалимского округа, с помощью своих дочерей восстановил следующий участок.
reading.question: What is unusual about Shallum's work on the wall?
options: He worked with the help of his daughters
reading.correct: He worked with the help of his daughters
reading.explain: Shallum son of Hallohesh rebuilt his section with the help of his daughters.
